'''Apalaí''' is a [[Cariban language]] spoken in [[Brazil]]. Approximately 450 [[Aparai people]] speak Apalaí. It is an [[agglutinative language]] which uses a rare [[object–verb–subject]] [[word order]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Apalai Indian Language (Aparai)|url=http://www.native-languages.org/apalai.htm|access-date=21 February 2016}}</ref>
